feeds.title: North Carolina Music Hall of Fame Blog
feeds.description: THE NORTH CAROLINA MUSIC HALL OF FAME, INC. was incorporated in the State of North Carolina on May 26, 1994, by Doug Croft, of Thomasville, North Carolina. The mission of the corporation is to recognize, promote and commemorate the musical heritage of the State of North Carolina.
